README: Malaysia bottom-up other opex = DOSM 2025 labour + Tian 2020 process electricity x TNB RP4 energy charge. Now INCLUDED (sourced): maintenance 1%/yr of capex (Kajal 2022), TNB capacity+network+fixed+KWTBB with max demand = average process load (LOWER BOUND, load factor 1). STILL OMITTED: HVAC/cleanroom, employer statutory contributions, 8% service tax; land/rent only as a non-MY Cai 2017 proxy case. The lower bottom-up total vs Liu's aggregate is an artefact of these omissions, NOT a Malaysia-vs-China finding. Only wage, tariff and FX are Malaysian; headcount and kWh/m2 are non-MY academic proxies. Materials and line capex remain Liu 2025 China values.
